subject: DeleteFileInStorage::handle
prompt: Uploaded files are removed from Uploadcare by the listener App\Domains\Contact\ManageDocuments\Listeners\DeleteFileInStorage::handle(). Which methods in the application code (app/, not tests) delete an App\Models\File model in a way that makes that listener run? Name the method that contains the delete call (for a call inside a closure, the named method that holds the closure), as Class::method. Leave out framework (Eloquent/Laravel) methods.
